scope_cautions: Prime bound uses nonzero coefficients and a separately proved characteristic-two case
CRT coefficients are Bezout-normalized and must not be silently simplified
Squarefree bound requires the first coefficient to be a unit; it is not a general gcd-sensitive composite bound
Reduced-modulus theorem bounds a sum defined at the reduced modulus, not an original-to-reduced lifting identity
Arbitrary-length incomplete-sum bounds apply to the mean-centered reciprocal phase, not the uncentered function
Exact Carlitz (1969) sign/trace normalization has not been compared equation-by-equation against the printed article
A successful Lean build certifies the formal statements under their displayed hypotheses, not novelty or historical source identity
